answer.value: The vision encoder was trained from scratch to handle variable image sizes and aspect ratios. The model is also a merged model that handles instruction-following, reasoning and coding in a single set of weights.
quotes:
We trained the vision encoder from
scratch to handle variable image sizes and aspect ratios.

Mistral Medium 3.5 is our first flagship merged model. It is a dense 128B model with a 256k context window, handling instruction-following, reasoning,
and coding in a single set of weights.
